reason: TerminalStateMismatch error variant cannot be triggered via public API. The recover_runtime_summary and recover_runtime_frame_seed functions take no expected-terminal parameter. Without an expected value to compare against, TerminalStateMismatch cannot be produced. Contract B-014 requires this variant but the API design defers this to a future recover_runtime_summary_with_expected variant.
compensating_evidence: RecoveryError::TerminalStateMismatch is properly defined in types.rs:84-89 with correct error variant semantics. The error type itself is tested in vb_storage/src/recovery/tests.rs:1660-1665 which verifies the variant construction and matching works. GAP tracked in vb-ty9 for API addition.
expiry: API addition recover_runtime_summary_with_expected merged, or explicit proof-reviewer waiver renewal
follow_up: Add recover_runtime_summary_with_expected API variant to unblock TerminalStateMismatch test coverage. Tracked in vb-ty9.
